commits.subject: Merge pull request #634 from dkounal/pgboundarrayfix
commits.body: db: fixed PostgreSQL array binding of over-allocated arrays and of trailing quotes
commits.author: ab

files.patch:
@@ -876,8 +876,16 @@ procedure TSqlDBPostgresStatement.BindParams;
           fPGParamLengths[i] := length(p^.VData);
         end
         else
+        begin
           // p^.VData was not already set by BindArrayJson() -> convert now
+          // - p^.VArray may have been over-allocated by the caller (e.g.
+          // TRestStorageExternal.InternalBatchStop allocates the whole remaining
+          // batch) and only the first p^.VInt64 = ValuesCount items are bound:
+          // the trailing '' items would be serialized as ,,,, = invalid literal
+          if length(p^.VArray) > p^.VInt64 then
+            SetLength(p^.VArray, p^.VInt64); // local copy - caller untouched
           BoundArrayToJsonArray(p^.VArray, RawUtf8(p^.VData)); // e.g. '{1,2,3}'
+        end;
     end
     else
       // single value parameter

commits.subject: db: fixed PostgreSQL array binding of over-allocated arrays and of trailing quotes
commits.body:
- TSqlDBPostgresStatement.ExecutePrepared serialized the whole p^.VArray, but
  TRestStorageExternal.InternalBatchStop allocates the arrays for the whole
  remaining batch and binds only ValuesCount (= p^.VInt64) items: any batch with
  several groups (e.g. Update then Add) sent {"a","b",,,,} and PostgreSQL failed
  with "22P02 malformed array literal" - now only the bound items are serialized
- BoundArrayToJsonArray recognized '' also against the closing quote of the SQL
  literal, so a value ending with ' (or with consecutive '') lost its quote(s)
  silently: 'abc ''x''' gave "abc 'x" - now a doubled quote is consumed as a pair
commits.author: Dimitris Kounalakis

files.patch:
@@ -876,8 +876,16 @@ procedure TSqlDBPostgresStatement.BindParams;
           fPGParamLengths[i] := length(p^.VData);
         end
         else
+        begin
           // p^.VData was not already set by BindArrayJson() -> convert now
+          // - p^.VArray may have been over-allocated by the caller (e.g.
+          // TRestStorageExternal.InternalBatchStop allocates the whole remaining
+          // batch) and only the first p^.VInt64 = ValuesCount items are bound:
+          // the trailing '' items would be serialized as ,,,, = invalid literal
+          if length(p^.VArray) > p^.VInt64 then
+            SetLength(p^.VArray, p^.VInt64); // local copy - caller untouched
           BoundArrayToJsonArray(p^.VArray, RawUtf8(p^.VData)); // e.g. '{1,2,3}'
+        end;
     end
     else
       // single value parameter
